steps.description:
Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Display the text "0:0" until Button A is pressed

2. When Button A is pressed, clear LCD screen

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Display the text "0:0" until Button A is pressed and then released

2. When Button A is pressed and then released, the stopwatch will start running

For example
0:0 at the start
0:1 after 1 second
0:2
...
0:59 after 59 seconds
1:0 after 1 minute

1:1

3. The maximum time this stopwatch can track is 59:59

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Display the text "0:0:0" until Button A is pressed and then released

2. When Button A is pressed and then released, the stopwatch will start running

For example
0:0:0 at the start
0:0:1 after 1 second
0:0:2
...
0:0:59 after 59 seconds
0:1:0 after 1 minute
0:1:1
...
0:59:59 after 59min 59 seconds
1:0:0 after 1 hour
1:0:1

3. The maximum time this stopwatch can track is 99:59:59

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Display the text "0:0:0" until Button A is pressed and then released

2. When Button A is pressed and then released, the stopwatch will start running

For example
0:0:0 at the start
0:0:1 after 1 second
0:0:2
...
0:0:59 after 59 seconds
0:1:0 after 1 minute
0:1:1
...
0:59:59 after 59min 59 seconds
1:0:0 after 1 hour
1:0:1

3. When the stopwatch time is not paused and Button A is pressed and released, the stopwatch time will pause 

4. When the stopwatch time is paused and Button A is pressed and released, the stopwatch time will continue to run again

5. Max time this stopwatch can track is 99:59:59
